title: Drunk 18-Year-Old Girl Goes Absolutely Nuts During Arrest
description:
On April 25, 2022, officers responded to a convenience store for an intoxicated female passed out in her vehicle in Weston, WI. Two customers said they found her sleeping in the back seat of the vehicle and were concerned for her wellbeing. 

While the officer was speaking with the female, he observed her slurred speech and an odor of intoxicants coming from her. After she tried to close her vehicle’s door on the officer multiple times, she refused to comply and ultimately made it a difficult night for the officers.
